attribution.title: Titanic iceberg
attribution.author: The chief steward of the liner Prinz Adalbert
attribution.description: The iceberg suspected of having sunk the RMS Titanic, photographed by the chief steward of the liner Prinz Adalbert on the morning of April 15, 1912, just a few miles south of where Titanic sank. The steward had not yet heard about Titanic's sinking, and he noticed the smear of what appeared to be red paint along the base of the iceberg, suggesting it had collided with a ship sometime in the previous 12 hours. Other accounts indicated that there were several icebergs in the vicinity of Titanic's collision.
